title: Charlie Ventura in Gene's band
summary: Roy recommended Ventura to Gene and kept him from quitting.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Oh, speaking of people... When you were with Gene, did you more or less discover Charlie Ventura? You found him, didn't you? Or you talked them into...

Well, what happened was that I used to go to a place and play, and he used to play down there, you know. And I told Gene about him, and he got the job in the band. But then he was going to leave. Because you know, when you go in a band, they don't give you nothin' to do, and he was getting disgusted. And I'm the one that kept him there, otherwise he would have been back in Philadelphia years ago.
He was working in the shipyards or something?
Yeah. Man, he's gone to pot, too, now. I seen him in Florida.
Oh, it must have been about... When I worked down in Fort Lauderdale.
Because somebody told me that he's much better now. He met a nice lady and moved to California, and he's in much better shape. She's taking good care of him.
Uh-huh. Man, I just talked to somebody who said he was still in Florida. He was down there repairing instruments.
Well, I don't remember who told me this, but it was not long ago. It was maybe a few months ago.
This is in Fort Lauderdale. Well, maybe so. That was in 1980, when I seen him.
Yeah, according to what I heard, this lady had a little money and she just took a liking to him and got him straightened out, and...

Well, that's good. He was a good player. I liked him. He was one of them cats that I dug, man. He was all right. I guess they were all right in their way. But they still had that fence up, you know what I mean?
